Pricing.title: Pricing
Pricing.subtitle: Choose the plan that fits your journey. Free for students, premium tools for serious applicants.
Pricing.sponsorSubtitle: For universities and recruiters who want to reach MENA students
Pricing.faqQ1: Is there really a free plan?
Pricing.faqA1: Yes! The Free plan is free forever. You can search universities, save favorites, and use the cost calculator without paying.
Pricing.faqA2: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. You'll keep access until the end of your billing period.
Pricing.faqA3: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. No questions asked.
Pricing.faqQ4: What payment methods do you accept?
Pricing.faqA4: We accept all major credit cards through Stripe. Regional payment methods coming soon.
Pricing.faqQ5: Is the sponsor plan per university?
Pricing.faqA5: Yes, each sponsor subscription covers one university. If you manage multiple universities, contact us for volume pricing.
Pricing.checkoutFailedDesc: Could not start checkout. Please try again.
Pricing.cancelSuccessDesc: You'll keep access until the end of your billing period.
Pricing.studentsSubtitle: Start free, upgrade when you're serious

Pricing.paymentsNotActiveDesc: Stripe billing is set up but needs API keys to process payments. You can still browse all plans — contact hello@edupath.com to upgrade manually.
